title: ADR-032: Server-Driven UI - Database-Driven Request Type Schemas
content:
# ADR-032: Server-Driven UI - Database-Driven Request Type Schemas

**Status**: Implemented
**Date**: 2026-02-15
**Context**: Roadmap Phase 2 — Server-Driven UI / Dynamic Forms
**Impact**: High — Enables new request types without code deployments or app updates
**Related**: ADR-007 (Polymorphic Request System), ADR-030 (Community Configuration)

---

## Problem

Adding a new request type (e.g., "dog walking", "tutoring") previously required:
1. Backend Zod schema changes (code)
2. UI schema changes (code)
3. Frontend form changes (Next.js)
4. Mobile app updates + App Store approval
5. Full deployment cycle

This process could take weeks and blocked rapid iteration.

---

## Decision: Hybrid Database-Driven Schema System

Store UI schemas in PostgreSQL as JSONB documents, enabling server-driven forms without code deployments.

**Hybrid validation strategy:**
- **Built-in types** (ride, service, event, borrow, generic): Zod schemas in code — type-safe, fast
- **Custom types** (dog walking, tutoring, etc.): JSON Schema stored in database — flexible, no deployment needed
- **Promotion path**: Custom types can be graduated to built-in status once proven

---

## Architecture

### Database Schema

```sql
CREATE TABLE requests.ui_schemas (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  type VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  label VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  icon VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  color VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NOT NULL,
  sections JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', -- draft, published, archived
  variant VARCHAR(50),         -- A/B testing (control, variant_a, etc.)
  rollout_percentage INTEGER DEFAULT 100,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE requests.ui_schema_versions (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  schema_id UUID REFERENCES requests.ui_schemas(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL,
  schema_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL,
  changed_by UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id),
  change_description TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);
```

### Caching (Three Layers)

| Layer | Mechanism | TTL | Purpose |
|-------|-----------|-----|----------|
| In-Memory | `Map<string, {schema, ts}>` | 1 hour | Fastest, per-instance |
| Redis | `schema:{type}:{variant}` | 1 hour | Cross-instance consistency |
| Database | PostgreSQL JSONB | Source of truth | Indexed on (type, status) |

Performance target: **<50ms for cached schema requests**.

### API Endpoints

#### Public (No Auth)

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `GET` | `/schemas` | List all published schemas |
| `GET` | `/schemas/:type` | Get full schema for a type (ETags, 1-hour cache headers) |
| `POST` | `/schemas/:type/validate` | Validate a payload against a schema |

#### Admin (Admin Role Required)

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/admin/schemas` | Create new schema (status=draft) |
| `GET` | `/admin/schemas` | List all schemas including drafts and archived |
| `GET` | `/admin/schemas/:id` | Get schema by ID |
| `PUT` | `/admin/schemas/:id` | Update schema (auto-increments version, type is immutable) |
| `POST` | `/admin/schemas/:id/publish` | Publish draft schema |
| `POST` | `/admin/schemas/:id/archive` | Archive published schema |
| `GET` | `/admin/schemas/:id/versions` | Get version history |
| `POST` | `/admin/schemas/:id/rollback/:version` | Rollback to a specific version |
| `POST` | `/admin/schemas/:id/variants` | Create A/B test variant |

---

## Implementation (Phases 1–3)

### Phase 1 — Database & Backend API (Complete: 2026-02-15)

- Migration `015_ui_schemas_dynamic.sql`: `requests.ui_schemas`, `requests.ui_schema_versions`, `requests.validation_rules`
- `SchemaService` with DB-first loading, in-memory + Redis caching, code fallback
- Admin auth middleware (`adminAuth.ts`) — separate from community admin role
- Full CRUD admin API: create, read, update, publish, archive, rollback, A/B variants
- Public read-only API with ETag caching

### Phase 2 — Admin UI (Complete: 2026-02-18)

Full web-based schema management tool at `/admin/schemas`:
- Schema list with status filtering
- Schema creation wizard
- Section/field editor with live preview
- Publish, archive, and rollback dialogs
- Version history browser

**Navigation**: Community founders access the Schema Manager via the **"Schema Manager →"** link in the community admin panel (visible only to the community creator).

### Phase 3 — Community Integration (Complete: 2026-02-18)

- Published schemas surface in `CommunityConfigEditor` alongside built-in types
- Community founders can enable/disable custom schemas and set karma multipliers
- Section/field edits in the schema editor persist to the database immediately

---

## End-to-End Workflow

```
Create Schema → Edit Sections/Fields → Publish
     ↓
Appears in Community Config → Founder Enables It → Set Karma Multiplier
     ↓
Members See New Request Type → Submit Requests with Custom Form
     ↓
(Optional) Monitor Metrics → Promote to Built-In Type (Zod)
```

**Time from idea to live**: < 5 minutes (vs. weeks previously).

---

## Consequences

### Positive
- New request types without any deployment
- Mobile app shows new types immediately (server-driven forms)
- A/B testing of form layouts without code changes
- Backward compatible — built-in types unchanged, code fallback if DB fails
- Community founders control which types their community uses

### Negative
- Two validation systems (Zod + JSON Schema) adds operational complexity
- Admin UI requires super_admin or admin role (currently not user-facing auth)
- Schema errors in production require rollback (version history mitigates this)

### Neutral
- Request service now owns both request logic and schema management
- Custom schemas stored as JSONB, consistent with `requests.help_requests.payload` pattern

---

## Key Files

| Layer | File |
|-------|------|
| Migration | `infrastructure/postgres/migrations/015_ui_schemas_dynamic.sql` |
| Backend | `services/request-service/src/routes/admin-schemas.ts` |
| Backend | `services/request-service/src/services/schemaService.ts` |
| Admin UI | `apps/frontend/src/pages/admin/schemas/` |
| Community Config | `apps/frontend/src/components/CommunityConfigEditor.tsx` |
| Admin Guide | `docs/guides/ADMIN_SCHEMA_MANAGEMENT.md` |

---

## Alternatives Considered

| Alternative | Why Rejected |
|---|---|
| Keep schemas in code (status quo) | Every change requires deployment + mobile update |
| Fully dynamic JSON Schema everywhere | Loses TypeScript type safety for core types |
| Separate schema-service | Added network dependency, more complex deployment |
